moments.title: Why India capped foreign money after the tiger economies crashed
moments.summary: A participant explains that European and American FIIs pushed up prices in the so-called tiger economies — Vietnam, Singapore, the Philippines — then pulled their money out in the late 90s and those economies crashed, and that India learned from it by capping how much FII money could come in and how fast it could be withdrawn.
moments.evidence: So India learning from that had like at that time set these caps that you know only so much FII money will be allowed in and it will not be allowed to be withdrawn
